tools.name: ibge_get_table_data
tools.description: Reads values from one SIDRA table for chosen variables, periods, territorial level, localities and breakdowns. The query is validated against the table's metadata first, so an invalid variable, period, level or category comes back naming the field and the valid options instead of IBGE's bare error.
